name: AFortAIPawn::RefreshDBNOAttributeStats
notes: Only runs for Role authority pawns. Reads the difficulty multiplier, then writes the scaled stat set (health and damage-style stats) into the attribute sets at +0xb78, +0xb80 and +0xb90 through SetNumericAttributeBase-style calls. Engine helper internals are not expanded beyond the calls listed in the evidence.
